title: Low Residuals, Wrong Value: Learning the Viscosity Solution of Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs Equations with PINNs
abstract: arXiv:2610.27193v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and other residual-trained solvers judge a candidate solution by the size of its sampled PDE residual. For first-order Hamilton-Jacobi equations this is not sufficient: the same equation and boundary data admit Lipschitz almost-everywhere solutions that differ from the viscosity solution by $O(1)$ while violating the equation only on sets of measure zero. We study whether residual minimization selects such solutions in a fixed-horizon pursuit-evasion game whose Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs value function is known in closed form on the circle $S^1$ and on the flat tori $\mathbb{T}^{2}$ and $\mathbb{T}^{4}$. We train four neural parameterizations with ten seeds on each geometry, 120 runs in total. translated_title: 低残差，错误值：基于物理信息神经网络（PINNs）学习Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs方程的粘性解
translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）及其他基于残差训练的求解器通过采样PDE残差的大小来评判候选解。对于一阶Hamilton-Jacobi方程而言，这并不充分：同一方程和边界数据容许与粘性解相差 $O(1)$ 的Lipschitz几乎处处解，而这些解仅在测度为零的集合上违反方程。我们研究在一个固定时界的追逃博弈中，残差最小化是否会选出此类解；该博弈的Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs值函数在圆 $S^1$ 以及平坦环面 $\mathbb{T}^{2}$ 和 $\mathbb{T}^{4}$ 上具有已知的闭式表达式。我们在每个几何结构上以十个随机种子训练四种神经参数化方法，共计120次运行。具有周期性Fourier特征的标准网络在全部30次运行中都收敛到折叠的几乎处处解：残差很小、捕获层梯度符合预期，但其值函数在大部分区域却是错误的。
tldr: 本文证明仅凭残差最小化不足以让PINNs学到Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs方程的粘性解，因为网络会收敛到残差很小但值函数与粘性解相差 $O(1)$ 的几乎处处解。
en_tdlr: Residual minimization alone is insufficient for PINNs to learn the viscosity solution of Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs equations, as they converge to almost-everywhere solutions with low residuals but values wrong by $O(1)$.
